tokens.npc_dota_hero_shredder_bio:
Rizzrack could still hear the screams in his mind. He worked, frantically turning wrenches, twisting screws, building and carving and forging. Sleep eluded him; he only built. Months had passed since he had shut himself in his uncle's workshop, and his deliverance was nearly complete. He rubbed his back as his eyes drifted shut, and saw a blanket of flowers floating on the placid waves of Augury Bay before exploding into a cloud of pollen that silenced lives as it seized the lungs. He woke with a choking start. For hours the rhythmic sound of a whetstone filled the shop as he sharpened a set of massive blades, his mind filled with images of strangling vines garroting neighbors, enwrapping homes. The flooding of Augury Bay had been nothing compared to the violent horrors the waters left to take root beyond the city walls.

But the saw-suit would make him strong and safe he thought, allowing himself this sliver of hope before the full might of his fear crashed into his fading mind. Branches and bark and blood. When the city fell, Rizzrack fled trees that walked, and fought, and killed. Trees had shattered the gates and swarmed into the city. Trees had crushed and thrashed and stomped the last that Augury Bay could muster in defense, and stalked the few fleeing refugees. In addled silence Rizzrack unspooled the thick chain from the suit's arm, his hands quaking as he inspected each link and ran a trembling finger along the claw attached at its end. The saw-suit was ready.

With his hand trembling he sparked the bladed machine to life. Terror drove him, terror of what awaited him and of what he would have to face to have any hope of calming his mind. As the saw-suit shuddered to life he knew he must face this fear, and he knew he wouldn't like it one bit.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Projectile|Link}}
** Has {{#var:Timber Chain value2}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Timber Chain value2 tal}}|25tal}})-{{M|projectile speed}}.
** Despite its visual effects, the Timber Chain effective area-of-effect is [[File:Dota2 Area Half-Circle Bottom icon.png|20px|Area-of-effect visualized.]] half of a [[wikipedia:sphere|sphere]] and not a flat circle.
*** Hence, it may latch onto trees on higher elevation as well.

* [[File:Dota2 Timbersaw Timber Chain Visualized icon-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Timbersaw Timber Chain Visualized icon-2.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Timbersaw Timber Chain Visualized icon-3.png|84px]]
** The chain travels either to the max travel distance, point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] ,  or until connecting with a {{M|tree}}.
*** Both leveling up the ability and learning the {{ValueColor||travel distance and speed|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4l}} do not update the current instance.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Vision|Base}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}}
**** Grants a non-lingering 100-radius vision around the chain {{M|projectile}} tip while traveling forward marked in red.
*** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** Can latch trees {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Timber Chain value3}}|v1={{#var:Timber Chain value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+{{#var:Timber Chain value3}}|v1={{#var:Timber Chain value1 tal}}}}|25tal}})-distance away with the max travel distance and the tree search radius.
*** [[File:Dota2 Timbersaw Timber Chain AoE Visualized icon.png|84px]] {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Timber Chain value4}}|v1={{#var:Timber Chain value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+{{#var:Timber Chain value4}}|v1={{#var:Timber Chain value1 tal}}}}|25tal}})-distance away with the max travel distance and the damage radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|B|21px]] .

* The ability effects are applied as follows upon latching onto a {{M|tree}}:
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}

**#** However, certain trees may prevent Timbersaw from going uphill, pushing him back down and does not destroy the tree.
**#* Stops the forced movement component upon being affected by the following sources while traveling:
**#** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
**#** Other {{M|forced movement}} sources.
**#** When interrupted by the aformentioned disable sources, the chain still moves Timbersaw for a very short distance, and applies its damage radius, but does not destroy the latched tree.
**#*** Considered bonus tree by {{A|Timbersaw|Whirling Death}}.
**#** Hence, the latched tree is destroyed once the chain {{M|projectile}} stops pulling.
**# {{M|Disarm}}
**# {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
**#* Grants a non-lingering 400-radius vision centered around the end location of the max travel distance, Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|Q|21px]] , or upon latching on a tree.
**# Affects all enemy units within damage radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|B|21px]] , including the following units:
**#* {{M|Invisible}} units.
**#* {{M|Untargetable}} units.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_shredder
data.bio_loc:
Rizzrack could still hear the screams in his mind. He worked, frantically turning wrenches, twisting screws, building and carving and forging. Sleep eluded him; he only built. Months had passed since he had shut himself in his uncle's workshop, and his deliverance was nearly complete. He rubbed his back as his eyes drifted shut, and saw a blanket of flowers floating on the placid waves of Augury Bay before exploding into a cloud of pollen that silenced lives as it seized the lungs. He woke with a choking start. For hours the rhythmic sound of a whetstone filled the shop as he sharpened a set of massive blades, his mind filled with images of strangling vines garroting neighbors, enwrapping homes. The flooding of Augury Bay had been nothing compared to the violent horrors the waters left to take root beyond the city walls.

But the saw-suit would make him strong and safe he thought, allowing himself this sliver of hope before the full might of his fear crashed into his fading mind. Branches and bark and blood. When the city fell, Rizzrack fled trees that walked, and fought, and killed. Trees had shattered the gates and swarmed into the city. Trees had crushed and thrashed and stomped the last that Augury Bay could muster in defense, and stalked the few fleeing refugees. In addled silence Rizzrack unspooled the thick chain from the suit's arm, his hands quaking as he inspected each link and ran a trembling finger along the claw attached at its end. The saw-suit was ready.

With his hand trembling he sparked the bladed machine to life. Terror drove him, terror of what awaited him and of what he would have to face to have any hope of calming his mind. As the saw-suit shuddered to life he knew he must face this fear, and he knew he wouldn't like it one bit.
